args.summary:
Model built and verified successfully for the 3×30 m precast small-box girder bridge (continuous unit, 4 girders per span).

Key modelling decisions:
- Idealization: spine_beam_2d, linear elastic; system = continuous (3 spans, no pier column geometry given, supports on rigid-pier bearings).
- Section: midspan small-box integrated to A_single = 1.13893 m², I_single = 0.35492 m⁴; combined girder A = 4.55572 m², I = 1.41967 m⁴ (4 girders).
- Material: C50, Ec = 34500 MPa (JTG 3362-2018 3.1.5); γ = 26.0 kN/m³ (JTG D60-2015 4.2.1, prestressed concrete upper limit); w = 118.45 kN/m, m = 12.074 t/m (girder self-weight only).
- Bearings (laminated elastomeric, 300×400 mm, 5×8 mm layers, per JTG 3362-2018 8.7): Abutments 0/3 and Pier 1 = PTFE sliding (8 per line, longitudinal free, Kh=0); Pier 2 = plain elastomeric fixed (8 per line, longitudinal spring Kh = 24000 kN/m). S = 10.714, Kv = 1.1357×10⁴·10³ kN/m per line.
- Live load: Class I, one-way, 11.5 m carriageway → 3 lanes, ξ = 0.78, qk = 10.5 kN/m, Pk = 320 kN per span.

Modal analysis (final stiffness set): f1 = 3.5115 Hz → impact factor μ = 0.2062 (JTG D60-2015 4.3.2).

Results: vertical frequencies [3.5115, 4.4734, 6.4665] Hz; self-weight reactions [1421.9, 3908.3, 3908.3, 1421.9] kN; self-weight support moments −10646.1 kN·m; max lane positive moment 8092.1 kN·m, max lane negative moment −5870.1 kN·m. All L1/L2/L3 checks passed.
